description: This Swift source file defines the NodeDisplayName enum which provides utility functions to determine display names for devices based on their interface idiom and device name, including handling of generic names and normalization of specific device names.

methods.name: isGeneric
methods.description: Checks if a given name is a generic device node name.

methods.name: defaultValue
methods.description: Returns a default device name based on the interface idiom.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves and returns the appropriate device display name based on existing name, device name, and interface idiom.

methods.name: normalizedDeviceName
methods.description: Normalizes the device name if it contains specific keywords like 'iphone', 'ipad', or 'ios'.
